channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Chris Webber | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Chris Webber from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Carlos Boozer on Chris Webber, Cameron Boozer
item.description:
Carlos Boozer on his son Cameron Boozer:

“I'm proud of him. First off, first off, I know this has been his dream to be in this position, to be in the NBA and have a chance to play for a team that loves him. And so, I just hope him to take in these moments like be where your feet are. Be present, enjoy these moments because they go by so fast. I still remember my first game against Sacramento back in 2002 when they had Chris Webber. And I was, you know, 20 something years ago. So I just hope him to be where your feet are, be as present as you can be, enjoy every moment, because they go by so fast.”

Carlos Boozer on Chris Webber, Cameron Boozer, Oct 9, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Matt Barnes on Chris Webber, JR Rider
item.description:
Matt Barnes:

“We turned a show into a whole company. Now we’re in boxing, MMA, launching NFL and MLB, something in FIFA, stepping into politics. Started All The Smoke Productions in 2024.JR Rider doc coming, Chris Webber doc coming. We didn’t know what we were building but we created an ecosystem.”

Matt Barnes on Chris Webber, JR Rider, Oct 16, 2025. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Cuttino Mobley on Yao Ming, Brad Miller, Chris Webber, Vlade Divac, Rick Adelman
item.description:
“It’s just the offense didn’t. Say we would’ve had Rick Adelman, for a fact, you would’ve seen more of Yao Ming. Like that Chris Webber, that Vlade Divac, Brad Miller type of passing. He had all of it.”

Cuttino Mobley on Yao Ming, Brad Miller, Chris Webber, Vlade Divac, Rick Adelman, Jul 3, 2025. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Doug Christie on Chris Webber, Vlade Divac, Predrag Stojakovic
item.description:
“[Chris Webber] has texted me numerous times. Bobby [Jackson] has texted me numerous times. Peja [Stojakovic] and Vlade [Divac], things that I can't say, but they definitely have texted me. It's nothing but love for all those guys because without them, I'm not sitting here.”

Doug Christie on Chris Webber, Vlade Divac, Predrag Stojakovic, Jan 16, 2025. Source: NBC Sports Bay Area.

item.title: Isiah Thomas on Chris Webber
item.description:
“The way they played the power forward position was so different and so unique. You know, their skill, their passing ability, Chris Webber's passing ability was off the charts.”

Isiah Thomas on Chris Webber, Sep 11, 2021. Source: Yahoo! Sports.

item.title: Karl Malone on Jerry Sloan, Chris Webber, John Stockton
item.description:
Karl Malone:

“I love Chris Webber but this was one time where I wanted to kick his ass. Right? So we had been wearing them out – at home – and Chris Webber started at half court looking for John Stockton. On the flip side, I say ‘Good on you Chris for studying the playbook. And we ran that four up and he didn’t even care. He hit Stockton right in the sternum with his elbow. I damn near felt it and [it] hurt. ...I felt so bad I went over to Coach [Jerry] Sloan and I said, ‘Coach, don’t run that again, please.’ Stock[ton] looked at me and said ‘No, I’m good’ and the next play– well, you know.”

Karl Malone on Jerry Sloan, Chris Webber, John Stockton, Jan 19, 2021. Source: The Players' Tribune.

item.title: Karl Malone on Charles Barkley, Chris Webber, Derrick Coleman
item.description:
Of his many claims, many of which were spot on, Malone listed three fellow power forwards who had more God-given ability than he did, but didn’t quite reach the same level of play.

“I’m going to tell you three guys that had more talent than Karl Malone -- Chris Webber, Derrick Coleman and Charles Barkley,”

Karl Malone on Charles Barkley, Chris Webber, Derrick Coleman, May 23, 2020. Source: NBC Sports.

item.title: Richard Jefferson on Mark Jackson, Chris Webber, Reggie Miller
item.description:
Jefferson told CBS Sports.

“I don't necessarily always watch basketball games to see what's going on with the basketball game. I watch basketball games to listen to how Mark Jackson speaks or Reggie Miller or Chris Webber. What can I take from them? Listening to their timing, figuring out what I would say and how I would say it in those moments. Very similar to a kid who's watching his favorite basketball player and then going out in the park and trying to emulate that move.”

Richard Jefferson on Mark Jackson, Chris Webber, Reggie Miller, Nov 19, 2018. Source: CBSSports.com.

item.title: Peja Stojakovic on Chris Webber, Mike Bibby
item.description:
Peja Stojakovic on his favorite memories in the building:

“I have so many. But the shot Mike Bibby hit off of Chris Webber's hand off that sealed Game 5 in the (2002) Western Conference Finals was one of the biggest shots for our team.”

Peja Stojakovic on Chris Webber, Mike Bibby, Mar 19, 2016. Source: NBA.com.
